title: Ryanair
headline: Ryanair Never Asked for This. 11M People Watched It.
desc: An unhinged AI spec ad that turned Ryanair’s obsession with extra fees into a viral hit.

blocks.x: Ryanair has built a brand around cheap flights, ruthless add-ons and a social presence that happily makes fun of its own customers. So we made an ad that pushed that personality even further.
The film wasn’t commissioned by Ryanair. It still travelled further than most real ads, generating 10.8 million views and proving that a sharp idea can fly without a media budget.
See the reaction on X

title: STAN
headline: Building a Sitcom for Satan
art: radial-gradient(circle at 74% 38%, #141414 0 15%, transparent 15.5%), repeating-linear-gradient(-22deg, transparent 0 18px, rgba(255,255,255,.4) 18px 20px), #C4161C
desc: 2nd Place at Runway's "Big Pitch for TV Shows that Don't Exist Yet"

blocks.x: Stan used to run Hell. He was good at it. Maybe too good. But an eternity of being the most hated being in the universe took its toll. The loneliness wore him down. So he packed up, came to Florida, and set out to do the one thing he'd never tried. Make a friend.

title: Tooth Fairy Tracker
headline: The World’s First Tooth Fairy Tracker
art: radial-gradient(circle at 76% 24%, #FF8CC0 0 12%, transparent 12.5%), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%, #FFF6D6 0 14%, transparent 14.5%), radial-gradient(circle, #FFFFFF 0 1.6px, transparent 2.2px) 0 0 / 30px 30px, #FF8CC0
desc: Making the Tooth Fairy real with personalized videos

blocks.x: Every child grows up with the Tooth Fairy, but unlike Santa, she has never had a world of her own — no home, no journey, and no way for children to experience the magic beyond a single night.

We created Kiki the Tooth Fairy, a digital experience that brings the Tooth Fairy tradition into the modern age. Through Kiki, children can track the Tooth Fairy’s journey, discover where she is, learn about her world, and experience the excitement of waiting for her visit.
The Tooth Fairy Tracker transforms a once-in-a-lifetime childhood moment into an interactive adventure, giving families a new way to celebrate lost teeth and create lasting memories.

Behind the experience, we built the creative world, character, and technology that power Kiki — combining storytelling, interactive design, and digital experiences to reinvent one of childhood’s most universal traditions.

title: Digital Mascot
headline: The NBA’s First Digital Mascot
desc: Winning the hearts & minds of Mavs fans with a brand new animated mascot - an NBA franchise first.

blocks.x: The Dallas Mavericks wanted to make things more fun and interesting for their fans. They needed a new way to get people excited, talk more about the team on social media, and also have some new items to sell that fans would love. So we created Mavrello Ballovic—a whimsical, basketball-obsessed character portrayed as a former owner of the Dallas Mavericks returning after a 30-year hiatus to reclaim his beloved franchise.
The narrative was enriched with lots of humor and fictional historic ties, creating a fun, engaging backstory.

blocks.cap: We grew Mavrello's social media presence from scratch - amassing over 10 million views in three weeks, significantly boosting the Mavericks' online presence.
We created Mavrello foam fingers which sold out in a matter of days.
Mavrello received a significant amount of press coverage, sparked conversations amongst fans, and created a huge buzz around the Mavericks.

role: Concepting and Art Direction. Developed the character's story and personality. Developed and implemented launch and social media strategy. Creation of all social and web assets. Collaboration with the animation studio. Screenwriting. Managing the mascot's social accounts and creation of all TikTok content.

title: Luka × LinkedIn
headline: Breaking LinkedIn with Luka Doncic
desc: Making Luka the first-ever, All-Star athlete to announce a sponsorship deal by taking on a C-Level Executive role and announcing it on LinkedIn.

blocks.x: Biosteel’s First Chief Hydration Officer
We created Luka’s LinkedIn page, complete with work experience and achievements. We even let fans endorse Luka in skills from Basketball to Magic.
Fans absolutely loved Luka’s new role. He got so many connection requests it literally broke LinkedIn, with his profile offline for a few hours.

blocks.cap: Twitter went absolutely mad upon hearing Luka's announcement
When his LinkedIn page broke down, we created a BioSteel email and an Out of Office message to keep the conversation going and the excitement high​.

title: AI Livestream
headline: World-Record AI Livestream
desc: Brought Synthesia's AI to a TikTok livestream to count up to a million, breaking a World Record along the way.

blocks.x: Synthesia needed a catchy way to show off their AI-video platform's power and realism.

So we decided to shock TikTok by beating MrBeast’s record of counting to 100,000, and counted all the way to 1 million in one continuous livestream. The campaign was a massive hit, pulling in a massive 9 million total views and catching the eyes of 2 million unique viewers.
The icing on the cake? We broke the World Record for ‘Longest Continuous Livestream'

role: Development of main concept and various content bits that aired over duration of the livestream.

title: Tsunoda Manga
headline: A Manga-Hit for Yuki Tsunoda
art: radial-gradient(circle at 74% 38%, #141414 0 15%, transparent 15.5%), repeating-linear-gradient(-22deg, transparent 0 18px, rgba(255,255,255,.4) 18px 20px), #FF4A2E
desc: Bringing driver Yuki Tsunoda’s story to life in a must-have Manga Comic to drive fans to Catawiki’s auction site.

blocks.x: Ahead of the Japanese Grand Prix, we collaborated with Manga artist Inko Ai Takita to make a comic of Yuki’s F1 adventure.
The limited edition prints sold like hot cakes, and spread on social to Yuki, AlphaTauri & CataWiki’s combined audience of 4.8m followers.

title: Merch
headline: Internet-Breaking Merch
art: radial-gradient(circle at 22% 28%, #FFF3C7 0 9%, transparent 9.5%), radial-gradient(circle at 66% 58%, #FFF3C7 0 14%, transparent 14.5%), radial-gradient(circle at 84% 20%, #FFF3C7 0 5%, transparent 5.5%), #E8C86E
desc: Letting NBA fans be part of the most popular friendship in basketball.

blocks.x: Fans LOVED the friendship between Luka Doncic and Boban Marjanovic, but there wasn't much out there to celebrate the bromance. So we whipped up a bunch of internet-breaking content and merch. Giving fans a way to feel closer to their favorite Mavs duo.
T-shirts and hoodies sold out online in hours, with fans going mad for Sunshine Of My Life Yellow, Bestie Blue, Soul Mate Orange, and Pally Pink colorways.
Utilizing the previously ignored pre-game walk to the locker room as media space, we launched the collection on game day in front of the TV cameras.

Working with Australian studio Struthless, we concepted and scripted an animated series following the pair’s wild adventures. The show was a massive hit with fans, garnering millions of views across social.
Bringing sports memorabilia into 2021, we created sports pin NFTs with LA design studio Glare. Available for fans to purchase.

role: Concepting. Art Direction. Collaboration with different design and animation studios. Screenwriting for Luka & Bobi episodes.

title: NFTs vs. Dick Pics
headline: Fighting Dick Pics with NFTs
desc: NFT the DP - An online campaign to combat the sending of unsolicited photos of genitalia.

blocks.x: We launched a website to encourage people who received unsolicited dick pics to mint the images into NFTs and sell them back to the senders - for a hefty price.

title: Pinterest Takes
headline: Launching Pinterest ’Takes’
desc: Rallying a Million Follows and Smoothly Launching 'Takes' through a Celeb Hobbies Showcase.

blocks.x: The new 'Takes' feature on Pinterest needed a bang-up introduction that would also showcase a personal side of star personalities. By diving into the creative hobbies of stars like Mariah Carey, Jennifer Lopez, and Serena Williams, it gave a cool, personal intro to Pinterest's new feature while letting fans see a different side of their favorite celebs. The campaign pulled in over a million follows on the 'Create Your Take' Pinterest Board.

role: Developed concepts for each celebrity and influencer. Script Development. Editing & design of all the 'Takes' that were posted on celebrity profiles.

title: NBA Highlights
headline: Changing the NBA Highlights Game
desc: Reinventing Sports Content for a New Generation of Sports Fans

blocks.x: Highlight reels were in need of a major revamp to engage both fans and non-fans. We created hype videos inspired by diverse areas of culture — transforming usual highlight reels into a magnet for a wider audience, transcending the typical sports fandom boundaries.
In the 21/22 season, Luka Dončić joined an exclusive list of just six players to earn three All-Star appearances before turning 23.
To celebrate his milestone, we created a TV commercial that showed the emotional parallels between his journey so far, and that of Mavericks legend Dirk Nowitzki.

role: Concepting, Copywriting and Art Direction for all highlights. Worked in close collaboration with animation studios to bring our vision to life.

title: YouTube, London
headline: A YouTube Exhibition in Central London
art: linear-gradient(#F3EFE6, #F3EFE6) 20% 26% / 16% 30% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#F3EFE6, #F3EFE6) 50% 22% / 22% 38% no-repeat, linear-gradient(#F3EFE6, #F3EFE6) 82% 28% / 11% 22% no-repeat, linear-gradient(0deg, #7E1717 0 32%, #C62828 32%)
desc: YouTube wanted to demonstrate the effectiveness of advertising through its platform in an engaging and memorable way. So we curated the AV Exhibition with interactive installations to showcase the dynamic potential of YouTube advertising.

blocks.x: Make your Money go Further
A kinetic sculpture, made by Dutch creators HeyHeydeHaas, to symbolize how YouTube and Omnicom make your investments go further.
See The Whole Picture

A sculpture made in collaboration with photographer Francis Augusto, where the full picture can only be seen from a specific angle, to show that YouTube & Omnicom ensure no gaps are left in your media plan.
YouTube Avenue
Using photographs that capture locations across the UK, the map & projection show the importance of ensuring your audiences are represented and reached, geographically.
Reached & Represented
The cog activated wheel showcases a fresh new selection of diverse creators who make content that reaches diverse audiences.
I Picked These Six Just for You
These six screens show the handpicked, human-verified content available only to Omnicom MediaGroup Clients.

role: Concept and development of all six art installations.

title: Lice Glow-Up
headline: Giving Lice a Glow-Up
art: radial-gradient(circle at 22% 28%, #DFF7E8 0 9%, transparent 9.5%), radial-gradient(circle at 66% 58%, #DFF7E8 0 14%, transparent 14.5%), radial-gradient(circle at 84% 20%, #DFF7E8 0 5%, transparent 5.5%), #5CCB8E
desc: Getting rid of lice is no fun for kids or parents. That's why The Lice Clinic (or L'Institut Anti-Poux in French) entrusted us to rethink their identity and help launch their new line of lice products.

blocks.x: The goal was simple: make the whole lice treatment experience less stressful and traumatic through thoughtful branding that balances compassion with clinical credibility. Ditching the expected sterile & scary tropes to create a truly fresh approach.
The end result? A total re-invention of how lice brands should look and feel across all touchpoints.
We redesigned all of their physical locations to match their new identity (stores are currently being updated - this in an AI/Photoshop render).
To guide kids through the lice treatment process, we created a cast of fun characters each representing a different step of the process.
We designed an end-to-end lice treatment kit, soon to be sold online and in-store. We also developed the packaging for all of their lice products.
We completely revamped their website and created their e-commerce storefront.

role: Creative Direction, Strategy, Art Direction, Copywriting, Product Development. Hired a designer and web designer to help bring the vision to life.
